description: Design tokens for BMW — ultra-premium automotive, minimal, editorial campaigns
notes: BMW aesthetic: ultra-premium automotive — minimal, editorial, confident
ZERO card borders, ZERO shadows, ZERO accent stripes or decorative rules
Typography is clean and confident — Arial/Helvetica, generous white space
BMW blue (#0066B1) used sparingly — ONLY for CTAs, never as decorative color
Rectangular buttons (not pill) — 2px radius, bold text, blue bg white text
Images are full-bleed within 600px container — no rounded corners on images
Dark backgrounds (#262626) used for contrast sections (electrified section)
Light gray (#F4F4F4) used for alternating section backgrounds (technology section)
Pure black (#000000) primary text color for headlines
Dark gray (#262626) for body text — softer than pure black but still premium
3-column model grid with centered images and short model names
This is a STANDALONE exception — not compatible with engine components
